title: Quenched Salt Bake Uruguayan Shrimp Bake
description: A traditional Uruguayan dish featuring jumbo shrimp baked in a claypot with a salt crust, perfect for a low-glycemic meal prep dinner. This recipe is bitter and shattering, with a focus on bold flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the coarse salt, brown rice flour, and water to form a thick paste.
Add the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, and dried oregano to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Place the jumbo shrimp in the center of a claypot.
Cover the shrimp with the salt paste, making sure to seal the edges of the claypot.
Bake the shrimp in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the claypot from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Crack the salt crust and serve the shrimp hot.
Garnish with fresh parsley or oregano, if desired.
